Step 06 - Generate status codes

Source: vignettes/step-06-gen-status-codes.Rmd
step-06-gen-status-codes.Rmd

Many titles carry a qualifier about the person’s status in the role: FORMER, INTERIM, PRESIDENT-ELECT, EX OFFICIO, AT LARGE, CO-CHAIR. The qualifier matters for analysis (an interim CEO, a past president) but would split one title into many crosswalk entries. gen_status_codes() detects each qualifier, records it as a 0/1 flag, and removes it from the title, or, for a few that change the role, keeps a standard form.

Before and after

before (TitleTxt5) after (TitleTxt6) flags set
FORMER CFO CFO FORMER.X
ACTING CFO CFO INTERIM.X
INTERIM EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR INTERIM.X
PRESIDENT-ELECT PRESIDENT FUTURE.X
PAST PRESIDENT PRESIDENT FORMER.X
OUTGOING TREASURER TREASURER OUTGOING.X
EMERITUS TRUSTEE TRUSTEE FORMER.X
BOARD MEMBER THRU BOARD MEMBER OUTGOING.X
TRUSTEE EXOFFICIO TRUSTEE EXOFFICIO.X
MEMBER AT LARGE MEMBER AT.LARGE.X
CO-CHAIR CHAIR CO.X
FIRST VICE PRESIDENT VICE PRESIDENT
REGIONAL DIRECTOR REGIONAL DIRECTOR REGIONAL.X
FOUNDER FOUNDER FOUNDER.X
EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR FOUNDER.X
TREASURER TREASURER

A person’s flags apply to all of their titles: in “FOUNDER & EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR”, both rows carry FOUNDER.X.

What it does 

gen_status_codes()
|
+- remove number words and ordinals (FIRST, SECOND, ...)
+- flag_and_keep()     flag, write one standard form:  EXOFFICIO, REGIONAL
+- flag_and_remove()   flag, delete the qualifier:     FORMER, FOUNDER, FUTURE, INTERIM,
|                                                     OUTGOING, PARTIAL, SCHED O, AT LARGE
+- get_variants()      all the spellings of one status, as one regular expression
+- share flags across a person's rows
+- clean up            drop a trailing EXOFFICIO, a CO- prefix (flag CO.X), NON-VOTING,
                       stray parentheses and punctuation
  • REGIONAL stays in the title, because a regional director is a different job. EXOFFICIO stays only when it is the whole title (EXOFFICIO BOARD MEMBER).
  • PARTIAL marks a partial year: a date in the title, or an outgoing, future or part-year status.
  • A title with both FORMER and FUTURE (“from … until”) keeps FORMER only.

The flags become former.x, interim.x, future.x, outgoing.x, partial.x, ex.officio.x, at.large.x, co.x, region.x, founder.x, sched.o.x and date.x in the final output. The Taxonomy article defines each one.

Assets

Asset Type Used for Load it with
status.codes crosswalk (package data) maps each qualifier spelling (status.variant) to its status (status.qualifier) get_status_codes() or data(status.codes)
number.words word list (package data) number words and ordinals to remove data(number.words)

The crosswalk’s source is data-raw/crosswalks/status-codes.csv in the source repository.

sc <- get_status_codes()
dim(sc)
#> [1] 294   2
table(sc$status.qualifier)
#> 
#>  AT LARGE   CURRENT EXOFFICIO    FORMER   FOUNDER    FUTURE   INTERIM  OUTGOING 
#>         5         1         4        14         4        30         6        33 
#>   PARTIAL  REGIONAL   SCHED O 
#>        10       182         5
head(sc[sc$status.qualifier == "INTERIM", ], 10)
#>    status.variant status.qualifier
#> 59            INT          INTERIM
#> 60        INTERIM          INTERIM
#> 61        PRESENT          INTERIM
#> 62         ACTING          INTERIM
#> 63           TEMP          INTERIM
#> 64      TEMPORARY          INTERIM

Try it 

get_variants("FORMER", sc)    # all the spellings of FORMER, as one regex
#> [1] "\\bCEASED\\b|\\bDECEASED\\b|\\bEMERITUS\\b|\\bFORMER\\b|\\bFRMR\\b|\\bIMMED PAST\\b|\\bIMMEDIATE\\b|\\bIMMEDIATE PA\\b|\\bIMMEDIATE PAST\\b|\\bPAST\\b|\\bIMMED PAST\\b|\\bPREVIOUS\\b|\\bPRIOR\\b|\\bRETIRED\\b"

x <- c("IMMEDIATE PAST CHAIR", "OUTGOING CEO", "ACTING DIRECTOR", "TREASURER")
remove_status(x, get_variants("FORMER",  sc))
#> [1] " CHAIR"          "OUTGOING CEO"    "ACTING DIRECTOR" "TREASURER"
remove_status(x, get_variants("INTERIM", sc))
#> [1] "IMMEDIATE PAST CHAIR" "OUTGOING CEO"         " DIRECTOR"           
#> [4] "TREASURER"

Input: TitleTxt5. Output: TitleTxt6, without status qualifiers, and one flag per status. Continue with step 07.
